title: Iron Words
description: My leg won't carry me another mile and this seal won't wait. Take it south to the gate at Kazan-Dun and put it in the warden's hand. Don't break it, and don't sell it.

objectives.description: Take the sealed letter from Borin Stonehammer
Put the seal in the warden's hand, unbroken

notes: Stage 2 of the Kazan-Dun rumour ladder (docs/design/kazan_dun_ladder.md). Borin is spawned in Elder Moor and cannot be moved from data, so the OFFER is paced instead: `prerequisites: [tharins_message]` means the player has already carried one letter to Thornfield and back before a wounded dwarf hands a stranger the hold's seal. NOT gated on logging_troubles, which was the first choice and is not completable: its `western_logging_camp`, `wolf_attack_site` and `dire_wolf_den` targets exist nowhere in the project, so gating on it would have been a wall. Access is not gated - a player may walk south at any hour and take kazan_dun_01 from the Gate Warden, which is ungated on purpose. The goblin objective no longer names goblins: the player finds out what holds the pass by meeting it. `dwarf_letter_delivered` is the flag that lets the specific southern rumours circulate; before it, the pools say only that something is wrong in the deep. Threat stated in outline only; the dwarf king, the regency and the soulstones stay out of this file so it cannot contradict the kazan_dun_* arc. 'Kazan-Dun' spelling matches WorldGrid's kazan_dun_entrance and this file's prior usage.
